Name: NO_POWER_NOTIFICATION
Description: Power off notification is not supported by host, device shall not assume any notification

Name: POWERED_ON
Description: Host shall notify before powering off the device, and keep power supplies alive and active until then

Name: POWER_OFF_SHORT
Description: Host is going to power off the device, The device shall respond within GENERIC_CMD_6_TIME.

Name: POWER_OFF_LONG
Description: Host is going to power off the device The device shall respond within POWER_OFF_LONG_TIME.
